scripts.start: npm run build -w apps/central && npm run start -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w apps/central && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/edge
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w apps/central && npm run test -w apps/server && npm run test -w apps/edge
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w apps/central && npm run deploy -w apps/edge
scripts.deploy:central: npm run build -w apps/central && node scripts/deploy-worker.mjs --central
